name: Irojikake Gakuen~ Shishunki Danshi Yūwaku Sakusen ~
original_name: 色仕掛け学園～思春期男子誘惑作戦～
source:
The protagonist is a shy boy with excellent grades who has just transferred schools, but the girls at his new school won't tolerate boys with good grades hanging around! Suzuka and Haru, two of the girls in his class, have started a trend of seducing any smart boys around so that they're unable to focus on studying, leaving the top grades open for them instead! 
From pressing their breasts to him innocuously, to flashing their panties and other things... the girls plan to make his attempts to focus on his work an impossible task! 

Will our protagonist be able to prevail against their relentless seductions and scrape a passing grade...?
translation:
主角是一个刚转学、成绩优秀的害羞男孩，但新学校的女孩们却不允许成绩好的男孩在他身边闲逛！铃鹿和春，他班上的两个女孩，已经开始了一种勾引周围聪明男孩的趋势，让他们无法专注于学习，而让他们有机会获得最高分！
从无伤大雅地用乳房压着他，到露出内裤等等……女孩们计划让他试图专注于工作成为一项不可能完成的任务！

我们的主角能否战胜他们无情的诱惑并获得及格分数……？
